title: Figures 29-30: LACE and deeply cooled rocket cycles; HOTOL evolution drawings
description: Figure 29 shows two color engine-cycle schematics labeled "LACE" and "Deeply Cooled," tracing H2, Air and LOX lines into a rocket chamber and nozzle; caption: "Figure 29. Two Rocket Air-Breathing Rocket Cycles to Mach 5.5. To the left is one employing liquefied air (LACE cycle). To the right is one employing high-pressure air cooled to near saturation." Figure 30 shows three side-view drawings of HOTOL variants (British Aerospace HOTOL with Rolls-Royce 545, Interim and Russian HOTOL with RD-0120, the latter two carried atop a large transport aircraft); caption: "Figure 30. HOTOL Evolution: From Aerodynamic Optimum Configuration to Practical Launcher Configuration."
